contract: RuleApplyBuff.Initiator is the recipient; existing initiator component contract is unchanged.
BuffCollection.AddBuff clones a pending context; a lost parent controller causes native MechanicsContext to substitute recipient as caster.
Shared resolver rejects only that native plain-buff-clone owner fallback with missing parent provenance; it stops at actual ability execution contexts.
Existing catalog, alignment predicate, trusted metadata, unknown-source policy and single startup setting remain unchanged.
limitations: Does not claim full custom/optional control delivery coverage, all source shapes, acquisition, final persistence/settings profiles or native UI acceptance.
Constructor calls that erase missing-caster provenance without a parent cannot be distinguished from explicit self-source; no speculative self-source rejection is added.
guardDiagnostic: First launch attempt refused after manual gate import created an untracked Python bytecode cache. Removed only that generated file, verified original source fingerprint, then launched through unchanged guard.
